title: The Impossible Vault
hook: Nobody has ever cracked the Impossible Vault. He has 5 minutes

messages.text: Nobody has ever cracked the Impossible Vault. Four locks. Five minutes. And if the alarm fills up... you leave with nothing.
messages.label: JOB 12 · THE IMPOSSIBLE VAULT

messages.text: Lock one: a dial with no guide. You turn it, and you listen. The clicks get louder when you're close. Click. Click. Click...
messages.label: LOCK 1/4 · DIAL

messages.text: Lock two: a steel plate. Drill too fast and the bit burns. Too loud, and the alarm climbs.
messages.label: LOCK 2/4 · DRILL

messages.text: Too hot, too hot... come on, come on!
Lock three flashed a colour code. Once. Red. Blue. Blue. Yellow... and one more he didn't catch.
messages.label: LOCK 3/4 · KEYPAD

messages.text: Wrong colour. The alarm jumped to ninety two percent. And then... footsteps. In the hallway.
messages.label: ALARM 92%

messages.text: Twenty one seconds left. One lock. He stuck a charge on the weak point, lit the fuse... and ran.
messages.label: LOCK 4/4 · CHARGE

messages.text: BOOM. The Impossible Vault swung open... and inside was more gold than anyone had ever seen.
messages.label: JOB 12 · COMPLETE

messages.text: This is Safecracker. Free on Pulsebox. box.pulseform.org. It's a computer game, so play it on a computer. Can you crack it before the alarm?
messages.label: Safecracker
